product.name: NeClip
product.summary: Local clipboard history, snippets and safe EN/RU layout correction for macOS

features: clipboard history for text, images and files
local search, pins, individual delete with undo and OCR
discoverable editable snippet folders, starter snippets and local placeholders
manual EN/RU layout correction with a configurable shortcut
optional conservative automatic EN/RU correction
per-application input-source memory without keyboard monitoring
fixed per-application input source without keyboard monitoring
Space preview while search is empty
one-shot append of the next accepted text
session ignore after undoing a false automatic correction
off-only automatic-correction safety shortcut
direct recent-history sequential paste
five configurable conflict-safe global shortcuts
sectioned local settings
configurable grapheme-safe menu label length
discoverable native structured-search filters
bounded menu browsing with complete on-demand search
atomic local history and snippet erasure
partial or on-quit history cleanup and bounded text capture
paste-and-delete only after successful direct-paste dispatch
bounded local storage and privacy exclusions
immutable password-manager capture protection and quick per-app capture rules
bounded snippet summaries with one-body-at-a-time loading
lossless fail-closed pasteboard restoration
self-verifying complete-ref secret scanning

permissions.pasteboard: Explained before monitoring; denied access fails closed on macOS 15.4+
permissions.accessibility: Optional; used for one-click paste and manual selected-text replacement
permissions.inputMonitoring: Requested only when automatic layout correction is explicitly enabled; per-application layout memory does not need it
